tickets.title: Support tickets
tickets.lead: Report a problem or ask for help — a computer that won't start, a billing question, broken equipment, an HR matter. Follow the answers here.
tickets.lead_manager: Requests from your team: assign them, reply and move them from open to resolved.
tickets.new_sub: Describe the problem clearly; the clinic's managers are notified straight away.
tickets.stat_unread_meta: Tickets with activity you haven't seen
tickets.search: Search by number, subject or text…
tickets.subject: Subject
tickets.subject_ph: e.g. Reception printer is not printing invoices
tickets.description_ph: What happened, since when, and what you already tried.
tickets.priority_help: Urgent: it stops patient care or the front desk right now.
tickets.author: Opened by
tickets.empty_text: When something doesn't work or you need help, open a ticket and follow the answers here.
tickets.close_confirm: Close this ticket? Nobody can reply on a closed ticket until a manager re-opens it.
tickets.conversation_sub: The request and every reply, oldest first.
tickets.ev_platform: {name} sent the ticket to DocBook support
tickets.reply_notifies: The other people on this ticket are notified.
tickets.platform_opt_help: E-mails this ticket to the DocBook team — for problems with the system itself.
tickets.platform_text: A problem with the DocBook system itself? Send this ticket to the DocBook team by e-mail; their answer comes to your e-mail.
tickets.platform_confirm: Send this ticket and its replies to DocBook support by e-mail?
tickets.platform_sent: The ticket was sent to DocBook support.
tickets.platform_failed: The ticket was saved, but it could not be sent to DocBook support. Try again from the ticket page.
tickets.platform_mail_foot: Sent from the clinic's support tickets by {name} <{email}>. Reply to this e-mail to answer them.
tickets.created_and_sent: Ticket #{n} opened and sent to DocBook support.
tickets.reply_reopened: Reply sent — the ticket is open again.

notify_settings.lead: Choose who also receives an e-mail when something important happens, and your own notification preferences.
notify_settings.lead_personal: Your own notification and privacy preferences.
notify_settings.email_sub: In-app notifications always appear under the bell. Tick an event to also send it by e-mail.
notify_settings.mail_off_text: Outgoing e-mail isn't configured on this server yet, so no e-mails are sent. Your choices are saved and apply as soon as it is.
notify_settings.ticket_help: Ticket e-mails go only to the people on the ticket (its author and assignee) who are ticked above; other addresses are not used.
notify_settings.invalid_emails: Some e-mail addresses are not valid.
notify_settings.privacy_note: Each person only receives what their role is allowed to see — for example, payment e-mails reach only members who can see payments. E-mails contain a short summary and a link; details open inside DocBook after signing in.
notify_settings.personal_sub: These apply to your account only.
notify_settings.sound: Play a sound for new notifications
notify_settings.sound_help: A short chime while DocBook is open in a visible tab.
notify_settings.presence_help: Colleagues won't see whether you are online or when you were last active.

events.po_acknowledged: Purchase order confirmed by the supplier

events_help.booking_online: A patient booked from the clinic's page or a booking link.
events_help.booking_cancelled: A patient cancelled from a reminder message or link.
events_help.payment_received: A card payment for an appointment went through.
events_help.invoice_paid: An invoice was paid at the front desk (optional — can be busy).
events_help.low_stock: A supply item reached its reorder level.
events_help.review_new: A patient left a review after a visit.
events_help.rep_visit_request: A medical rep asked for a visit slot.
events_help.po_acknowledged: A supplier confirmed a purchase order you sent.
events_help.budget_alert: Spending passed a budget's alert threshold.
events_help.ticket_reply: New tickets, assignments, replies and status changes.

doctor_mail.title: E-mail the patient
doctor_mail.sub: Sent in your name from the clinic; the patient's reply comes back to you.
doctor_mail.not_configured: Outgoing e-mail isn't set up on this server, so this message can't be sent.
doctor_mail.body_ph: Write your message to the patient…
doctor_mail.body_help: Kept in the patient's record. Don't include information the patient hasn't already been given.
doctor_mail.docs_help: Only documents already shared with the patient are listed; PDFs are built from the record as it is now.
doctor_mail.no_docs: No documents have been shared with this patient yet.
doctor_mail.sent_with: E-mail sent to the patient with {n} attachments.
doctor_mail.mail_foot: {clinic} · {phone} — reply to this e-mail to answer the clinic.

errors_teamops.TICKET_CLOSED: This ticket is closed. Ask a manager to re-open it.
errors_teamops.SUPPORT_UNAVAILABLE: Sending to DocBook support isn't available on this server.
errors_teamops.ALREADY_SENT: This ticket was already sent to DocBook support.
errors_teamops.PATIENT_NO_EMAIL: This patient has no e-mail address. Add one to the patient's file first.
errors_teamops.MAIL_NOT_CONFIGURED: Outgoing e-mail isn't set up on this server.
errors_teamops.MAIL_FAILED: The e-mail could not be sent. Please try again later.
errors_teamops.RATE_LIMITED: Too many e-mails in a short time. Please try again in a little while.
errors_teamops.PERMISSION_DENIED: You can't make this change on this ticket.
